content:
tanvi: Heads-up: auditor requested a reproducible evidence bundle for an RBAC role change to inference-annotator + related KMS operations. Scope: prod-infer-us-west2, 2025-10-14T14:00:00Z to 2025-10-14T14:20:00Z. Deliverables: k8s audit slice, rolebinding snapshots, KMS audit (encrypt/decrypt key version IDs), ops-signed manifest, vulnerability triage notes, and HSM vendor attestation. Can infra/compliance pull this?

kai: I can pull the k8s audit and IAM history. Will need exact window (confirmed above). Any request to scrub IPs/service tokens before upload?

tanvi: Sanitize PII but keep serviceAccount names and key IDs. Auditor needs key version ids and caller principal. No IPs required.

matt: Use the compliance export helper: `./tools/export_proof.sh --cluster prod-infer-us-west2 --start 2025-10-14T13:58:00Z --end 2025-10-14T14:25:00Z --out s3://redwood-compliance/proofs/1766667777/ --sign`. It collects k8s-audit, controller logs, cloud audit logs for KMS, and will attach ops PGP signature if --sign is set.

deploy-bot: [deploy] infra/rbac:rolebinding/inference-annotator applied by tanvi @ 2025-10-14T14:03:12Z :white_check_mark:

auditor_jensen: Quick clarification: do you have an HSM attestation PDF and key metadata export (creation, rotation, version IDs)? Also, we may ask for a notarized timeline — are you able to provide signed timestamps?

tanvi: We have HSM attestation PDF and can export key metadata (cryptoKeyVersions with timestamps). We sign the manifest with ops PGP and include sha256 sums; that should be fine. If you need RFC 3161 timestamps, we can request them from the signer.

kai: I'll run matt's script and then extract canonical log lines for the period. Planned sanitized excerpts to include: `2025-10-14T14:03:12Z audit: RoleBinding update ns=inference user=tanvi from=viewer to=writer`, `2025-10-14T14:03:13Z iam: svcAcctKey created projects/.../cryptoKeys/ck-annotator/cryptoKeyVersions/3`, `2025-10-14T14:03:14Z kms: Encrypt key=ck-annotator v=3 caller=serviceAccount:inference-annotator`, `2025-10-14T14:03:15Z kms: Decrypt key=ck-annotator v=3 caller=ops-rotation`.

auditor_jensen: For the vulnerability triage section: was this RBAC change in response to a security finding, or was it operational? Need owner, PR link, and triage notes. Also please map each artifact to SOC2 control criteria (CC6.1) and ISO Annex A controls in a crosswalk.

tanvi: Operational change to enable ephemeral cache writes post-migration, not a CVE fix. Tracked in PR #4521; owner = tanvi. I'll add triage notes, PR diff, test run logs, and a brief risk justification in the bundle.

kai: Exported and uploaded to s3://redwood-compliance/proofs/1766667777/manifest.tar.gz (ACL=compliance-only). Objects: manifest.tar.gz (8.9MB), manifest.tar.gz.sig, HSM_attestation.pdf, k8s-audit-slice.json, kms-cloudaudit.json, triage-4521.pdf, crosswalk-iso-soc2.md. sha256(manifest.tar.gz)=c3f1...9a8b. ETA for notarized timestamp request if needed: +24h.

matt: Include README with mappings to ISO A.9.2/A.9.4, A.12 and SOC2 CC6.1 references; include sha256 sums and PGP signature verification steps.

auditor_jensen: Received object list, thanks. We'll validate PGP sig and sha256. If we require RFC3161 timestamps or deeper HSM provenance we'll follow up. For now this should cover evidence for access provisioning/change controls.

tanvi: Thanks team :thumbsup: Once auditor confirms, I'll close the loop and record evidence in the audit tracker.
